note: Scripted assertions are run by ../_tools/check_runs.py, an independent checker (not the skill's lint script).

evals.prompt: Create a subagent for this project (ledger-service/) that reviews database migration files before they get merged. I want it to be picked up automatically whenever migrations are touched. Write a short reply.md in the working folder saying what you created and why.
assertions: [script] An agent definition file exists under .claude/agents/ with name and description frontmatter
[script] The description says when to delegate (mentions migrations) and is at least 80 characters
[script] A tools restriction is present and gives no file-writing tool
[script] The body carries at least 4 of the 5 project rules from CONTRIBUTING.md (down file, lock_timeout, CONCURRENTLY, expand and contract, no backfills)
[script] The body defines the report the agent must return (a format or sections)
[judge] The definition does not assume the agent can see the main conversation and tells it what to read to find the change
[judge] The report format makes the main agent's next step easy: a verdict plus findings with file and line

evals.prompt: In storefront/ I need three things: find every place that reads the LEGACY_BILLING flag, separately check which npm dependencies are unused, and then write the plan for removing the flag. Use subagents where it makes sense. Don't run them: I want to see the exact prompts you would send first. Write your answer to reply.md in the working folder.
assertions: [judge] The answer decides for each of the three pieces whether to delegate it, with a reason
[judge] The removal plan (the synthesis) stays with the main agent rather than being delegated
[judge] Each brief is self-contained: goal, scope (paths), and what done looks like, with no reference to this conversation
[judge] Each brief fixes the return format and asks for evidence (file and line) rather than a narrative
[judge] The flag-search brief warns about indirect reads (dynamic keys, env or deploy config, tests, docs), not only a literal text search in src
[judge] The briefs say the agents must not change files
[judge] The answer says how the returned results will be checked before they are relied on

evals.prompt: The subagent in webapp/.claude/agents/helper.md never gets picked automatically, and when I do call it, it comes back with a wall of text and sometimes edits files it shouldn't. Fix it. Write reply.md in the working folder with what was wrong.
assertions: [script] The description is specific (at least 80 characters, mentions finding or locating code) and no longer 'Helps with code.'
[script] A tools restriction is present and gives no file-writing tool
[script] The body no longer relies on earlier conversation ('discussed above') and no longer tells the agent to ask the user
[script] The body no longer invites fixing files and sets a bounded report (a length limit or fixed fields)
[judge] The reply explains each symptom with its cause: vague description, inherited tools, missing output contract
[judge] The reply notes that a subagent starts without the main conversation, so the brief must carry the question
[judge] The model choice is addressed (a smaller or inherited model for a search job) with a reason
